segments.mil7.2.3:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘kalandakassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban”ti?
segments.mil7.2.3:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, kalandako paṭisattumhi opatante naṅguṭṭhaṃ papphoṭetvā mahantaṃ katvā teneva naṅguṭṭhalaguḷena paṭisattuṃ paṭibāhati,
segments.mil7.2.3:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena kilesasattumhi opatante satipaṭṭhānalaguḷaṃ papphoṭetvā mahantaṃ katvā teneva satipaṭṭhānalaguḷena sabbakilesā paṭibāhitabbā.
segments.mil7.2.3:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, kalandakassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
